title: ff7-web Tier 2 result, format 1
description: What a Tier 2 run writes to /out/results.json inside the sandbox. The trusted validator (harness/private-eval/validate/validate.js) enforces these rules in its own code, plus rules a schema can't express: the file is at most 64 KiB, nesting depth is at most 6, every scenario name and metric key is listed in the run's --expect file (built from the PR's scenario files before the run), scenario names are unique, and a non-integer metric has at most 3 decimal places and lies within +-1e6. Anything else rejects the whole output. Documentation only: the validator never loads this file.

metrics.description: Numbers only: counts, timings, addresses, coordinates. Integers within +-2^32.
